reason: A DeepSeek Harness development plugin that watches dependency lockfile changes and live-reloads upgraded plugins with rollback on failures, while reporting outcomes through logs, terminal messages, and optional web notifications.

summaries.zh: 通过监视配置文件中的 pnpm-lock.yaml 变化，在不重启 DeepSeek Harness 的情况下热重载已升级的插件，并在失败时回滚到可用版本。
summaries.en: Hot-reloads upgraded DeepSeek Harness plugins when dependency versions change, rolling back failed reloads without restarting the application.

capabilities: Watches a profile pnpm lockfile for plugin version changes
Reads installed package versions and plugin metadata
Invalidates module caches and reloads running plugins in place
Reinstantiates and rolls back plugin fibers when initialization fails
Writes persistent state to a profile file using an atomic rename
Serves an unauthenticated web event endpoint for reload notifications
Displays reload outcomes in the terminal and dsh web app
